qa_pairs.question: What is the function of the CPU graph displayed on a GPU task page within the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The CPU graph on a GPU task page in the Metrix portal allows users to visualize the usage of the requested CPU cores over time.

qa_pairs.question: How can users interact with the CPU graph on a GPU task page to customize their view?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can interact with the CPU graph on a GPU task page by selecting or deselecting different CPU cores as needed, using the options provided on the right side of the graph.

qa_pairs.question: Are there any limitations to when the CPU graph is available on a GPU task page?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, the CPU graph is not available for very short tasks.
